description: This Java class implements the MessageSourceService interface and provides initialization with message properties before Spring startup, managing message retrieval and message source management for the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: DefaultMessageSourceServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements message source service to load and retrieve messages from a properties file during application startup, following singleton pattern.

methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the service, initializing it if necessary.
